creators.name: Amap (Alibaba)
creators.role: Alibaba Group's mapping and navigation service, whose CV Lab builds generative 3D Earth and world models
creators.role_zh: 阿里巴巴集团旗下的地图与导航服务，其视觉实验室（CV Lab）研发生成式三维地球与世界模型
creators.bio: Amap (Gaode) is the digital map and navigation service of Alibaba Group; its CV Lab released the ABot-Earth generative 3D Earth model in 2026.
creators.bio_zh: 高德是阿里巴巴集团的数字地图与导航服务；其视觉实验室于 2026 年发布了生成式三维地球模型 ABot-Earth。
creators.why: A map company is turning satellite imagery into generated, walkable 3D cities at city and planet scale.
creators.why_zh: 一家地图公司正在把卫星影像变成可漫游的生成式三维城市，规模从城市延伸到整个星球。

creators.name: Jiahao Lu
creators.role: PhD researcher, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学博士研究者
creators.bio: Co-first author of GAE (2026), a geometry-native latent space for world generation developed with Tencent ARC Lab.
creators.bio_zh: GAE（2026）的共同第一作者；该工作与腾讯 ARC 实验室合作，为世界生成提出了几何原生的潜空间。
creators.why: GAE argues that 3D consistency in generated worlds is a representation problem, not only a modelling one.
creators.why_zh: GAE 认为，生成世界的三维一致性不只是建模问题，也是表示问题。

creators.name: Wangbo Yu
creators.bio: First author of ViewCrafter (2024, TPAMI 2025) and of the follow-up WorldCrafter video world model (2026).
creators.bio_zh: ViewCrafter（2024，TPAMI 2025）及其后续视频世界模型 WorldCrafter（2026）的第一作者。
creators.why: ViewCrafter's point-cloud-guided video diffusion became a template for camera-controlled scene generation.
creators.why_zh: ViewCrafter 以点云引导视频扩散的做法，成为相机可控场景生成的常用范式。

creators.name: Nicolas von Lützow
creators.role: PhD researcher, Visual Computing & AI Lab, Technical University of Munich
creators.role_zh: 慕尼黑工业大学视觉计算与人工智能实验室博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of GaussianGPT (ECCV 2026 oral), developed in Matthias Niessner's group at TUM.
creators.bio_zh: GaussianGPT（ECCV 2026 口头报告）的第一作者，该工作完成于慕尼黑工业大学 Matthias Niessner 的研究组。
creators.why: GaussianGPT is an early fully autoregressive generator of explicit 3D scenes, an alternative to diffusion.
creators.why_zh: GaussianGPT 是较早的完全自回归式显式三维场景生成器，为扩散模型之外提供了另一条路线。

creators.name: Jiaxin Huang
creators.role: Researcher, X-D Lab (Yiyi Liao), Zhejiang University
creators.role_zh: 浙江大学 X-D Lab（廖依伊课题组）研究者
creators.bio: First author of Gen3R (CVPR 2026), which couples a video diffusion model with the VGGT reconstruction model.
creators.bio_zh: Gen3R（CVPR 2026）的第一作者，该工作把视频扩散模型与 VGGT 重建模型耦合在一起。
creators.why: Gen3R makes every generated view arrive with camera poses, depth and a point cloud that can be checked.
creators.why_zh: Gen3R 让每个生成视角都附带可检验的相机位姿、深度和点云。

creators.name: Horizon Robotics
creators.role: Chinese maker of AI processors and software for vehicles and robots
creators.role_zh: 中国的车载与机器人 AI 芯片及软件公司
creators.bio: Horizon Robotics develops AI processors and driving software; its robotics team released the open EmbodiedGen toolkit (2025) and EmbodiedGen V2 (2026).
creators.bio_zh: 地平线研发 AI 处理器与智能驾驶软件；其机器人团队开源了 EmbodiedGen 工具包（2025）和 EmbodiedGen V2（2026）。
creators.why: It is one of the Chinese companies open-sourcing generators of simulation-ready 3D worlds.
creators.why_zh: 它是开源“可直接仿真”的三维世界生成器的中国公司之一。

creators.name: Muyao Niu
creators.role: PhD researcher, The University of Tokyo; works with Alaya Lab
creators.role_zh: 东京大学博士研究者，与 Alaya Lab 合作
creators.bio: First author of WorldSculpt (2026), a joint project of Alaya Lab and the University of Tokyo.
creators.bio_zh: WorldSculpt（2026）的第一作者，该项目由 Alaya Lab 与东京大学合作完成。
creators.why: WorldSculpt shows how generated or captured worlds can be broken into separate, editable objects.
creators.why_zh: WorldSculpt 展示了如何把生成或拍摄得到的世界拆成一个个可单独编辑的物体。

creators.name: Manycore Tech
creators.role: Hangzhou company behind the Kujiale interior-design platform; open-sources spatial AI models
creators.role_zh: 杭州公司，运营酷家乐室内设计平台，并开源空间智能模型
creators.bio: Manycore Tech runs the Kujiale interior-design platform and has open-sourced spatial AI models such as SpatialLM (2025) and SpatialGen (2025).
creators.bio_zh: 群核科技运营酷家乐室内设计平台，并开源了 SpatialLM（2025）和 SpatialGen（2025）等空间智能模型。
creators.why: Its large store of designed interiors feeds layout-controlled indoor scene generation.
creators.why_zh: 它积累的大量室内设计数据，支撑起可由布局控制的室内场景生成。

creators.name: Rafail Fridman
creators.role: Researcher, Weizmann Institute of Science (Tali Dekel's group)
creators.role_zh: 魏茨曼科学研究所研究者（Tali Dekel 课题组）
creators.bio: First author of SceneScape (NeurIPS 2023), text-driven perpetual scene generation with a unified mesh.
creators.bio_zh: SceneScape（NeurIPS 2023）的第一作者，该工作以统一网格实现文本驱动的无限场景生成。
creators.why: SceneScape was one of the first methods to keep an explicit 3D memory during an endless generated walk.
creators.why_zh: SceneScape 是最早在无限生成的漫游中保留显式三维记忆的方法之一。

creators.name: Sensen Gao
creators.bio: Co-first author of PixWorld (2026), developed at Nanyang Technological University with AIsphere, the company behind PixVerse.
creators.bio_zh: PixWorld（2026）的共同第一作者，该工作由南洋理工大学与 PixVerse 背后的爱诗科技合作完成。
creators.why: PixWorld treats 3D scene generation and reconstruction as one pixel-space diffusion problem.
creators.why_zh: PixWorld 把三维场景生成与重建视为同一个像素空间扩散问题。

works.title: ABot-Earth
works.description: Amap's generative 3D Earth model builds walkable 3D Gaussian-splat city districts from satellite imagery, in under ten minutes per square kilometre, and streams them with level of detail in a public web viewer where visitors fly between generated cities, the Moon and Mars. Version 0.5 (technical report, June 2026) was followed by 0.7 on 2026-09-10; creating your own 1 km² tile from text or a reference image is whitelist-only as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: 高德的生成式三维地球模型：以卫星影像为条件生成可漫游的三维高斯泼溅城市街区，每平方公里不到 10 分钟，并以分级细节（LOD）在公开的网页浏览器中流式加载，访客可以在生成的城市、月球和火星之间穿梭。0.5 版技术报告发布于 2026 年 6 月，0.7 版于 2026 年 9 月 10 日上线；截至 2026 年 10 月，用文字或参考图创作自己的 1 平方公里地块仍仅向白名单用户开放。
works.idea_en: Grounding generation in satellite imagery yields city-scale scenes that follow a real place's layout, so a study could stage an encounter on a recognisable street without capturing it on foot.
works.idea_zh: 以卫星影像为生成依据，得到的城市级场景遵循真实地点的布局，研究可以在一条可辨认的街道上布置情境，而无需实地采集。
works.method: A generative model formulated directly on 3D Gaussian splats is trained on a corpus of real-world urban reconstructions and, at inference, synthesises geometry and texture conditioned only on geo-referenced satellite tiles, packed into hierarchical LOD for web map engines.
works.method_zh: 直接在三维高斯泼溅表示上构建的生成模型，用大量真实城市重建数据训练；推理时仅以带地理坐标的卫星影像为条件合成几何与纹理，并打包成分级 LOD，供网页地图引擎实时渲染。
works.specs: < 10 min per km² · 1 km² tiles · hierarchical LOD · web viewer

works.title: GAE (Geometry-Native Autoencoder)
works.description: An open 1B-parameter generator from HKUST and Tencent ARC Lab that turns one image and a prompt into a camera-controlled multi-view video whose every frame also decodes into depth, camera poses and point maps, so the generated world comes out as consistent 3D rather than pixels alone.
works.description_zh: 香港科技大学与腾讯 ARC 实验室推出的开源 10 亿参数生成模型：由一张图像和一句提示生成相机可控的多视角视频，每一帧同时可解码为深度、相机位姿和点图，生成的世界因此直接带有一致的三维结构，而不只是像素。
works.idea_en: Generating in a latent that already encodes geometry, instead of checking geometry afterwards, is one route to video-like worlds that stay put when you look back.
works.idea_zh: 在本身就编码几何的潜空间里生成，而不是事后再补几何，是让类视频世界在回头看时仍保持不变的一条路径。
works.method: Features of a geometry foundation model are reparameterised into a compact latent (the geometry-native autoencoder) that decodes jointly to appearance, depth, cameras and point maps, and a standard conditional flow-matching model generates directly in that latent; with the generator and training protocol held fixed, the authors report better visual quality and measured 3D coherence than with an appearance-only latent.
works.method_zh: 把几何基础模型的特征重新参数化为一个紧凑潜空间（几何原生自编码器），它可同时解码出外观、深度、相机与点图；再用标准的条件流匹配模型直接在该潜空间中生成。作者报告，在生成器与训练流程不变的对照中，换用该潜空间后，画质和独立测量的三维一致性都优于只编码外观的潜空间。
works.specs: 1B parameters · image + prompt → multi-view video with depth, cameras and point maps

paper.title: GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation

works.title: ViewCrafter
works.description: From one or a few photos, ViewCrafter generates new views along a chosen camera path with a video diffusion model guided by a point cloud, then fits 3D Gaussians to the result so the scene can be viewed in real time; code and weights are open.
works.description_zh: ViewCrafter 从一张或几张照片出发，用以点云为引导的视频扩散模型沿指定镜头路径生成新视角，再用这些画面拟合三维高斯，使场景可以实时浏览；代码与权重均已开源。
works.idea_en: Coarse 3D points tell the video model where things are and the video model fills in how they look: a division of labour many later world generators adopted.
works.idea_zh: 粗略的三维点告诉视频模型物体在哪里，视频模型补上它们看起来的样子：后来许多世界生成器都采用了这种分工。
works.method: A point cloud reconstructed from the input images is rendered along the target trajectory and conditions an image-to-video diffusion model; iterative view synthesis with camera-trajectory planning extends coverage, and the generated frames are used to optimise 3D Gaussian splats.
works.method_zh: 先由输入图像重建点云，沿目标轨迹渲染后作为图生视频扩散模型的条件；再通过迭代视角合成与镜头轨迹规划逐步扩大覆盖范围，最后用生成的画面优化三维高斯泼溅。

paper.title: ViewCrafter: Taming Video Diffusion Models for High-fidelity Novel View Synthesis

works.title: Explorer
works.description: Odyssey's first world model turned a single image into a photorealistic 3D Gaussian-splat world in about ten minutes, which artists could open and hand-edit in Unreal, Houdini or Blender; Odyssey tested the worlds on a virtual-production stage at Garden Studios in London. Access was by contact request rather than a public app, and Odyssey has since moved to real-time interactive video world models (Odyssey-2, Odyssey-3).
works.description_zh: Odyssey 的第一个世界模型：约 10 分钟把一张图像变成照片级的三维高斯泼溅世界，艺术家可以在 Unreal、Houdini 或 Blender 中打开并手工修改；Odyssey 还在伦敦 Garden Studios 的虚拟制片棚里测试了这些世界。它通过联系申请提供，而非公开应用；Odyssey 此后转向实时交互的视频世界模型（Odyssey-2、Odyssey-3）。
works.idea_en: Choosing splats as the output meant a generated world could go straight into film and game tools for hand-editing, trading real-time generation for an editable asset.
works.idea_zh: 选择高斯泼溅作为输出，意味着生成的世界可以直接进入影视和游戏工具供人手工修改：放弃实时生成，换来可编辑的资产。
works.method: An image-to-world generative model (architecture unpublished) outputs a 3D Gaussian-splat scene; Odyssey reported average generation times of about 10 minutes and early experiments with moving elements such as snow, water and fire.
works.method_zh: 图像到世界的生成模型（架构未公开）输出三维高斯泼溅场景；Odyssey 称平均生成时间约 10 分钟，并在早期实验中加入了雪、水、火等运动元素。

works.title: GaussianGPT
works.description: A transformer that writes a 3D Gaussian-splat room token by token, the way a language model writes text, so one model can generate a scene from scratch, complete a partial one or extend a room outward, with sampling temperature controlling how varied the result is; code and checkpoints are open.
works.description_zh: 一个像语言模型写文字那样逐个 token 写出三维高斯泼溅房间的 Transformer：同一个模型既能从零生成场景，也能补全残缺场景或向外扩展房间，并用采样温度控制结果的多样程度；代码与检查点已开源。
works.idea_en: Building a scene step by step makes 'keep this part, regenerate the rest' a native operation, which is what controlled variation of a setting needs.
works.idea_zh: 逐步搭建场景，让“保留这部分、重新生成其余部分”成为原生操作，这正是有控制地改变一个情境所需要的。
works.method: A sparse 3D convolutional autoencoder with vector quantisation compresses Gaussians into a discrete latent grid; the serialised tokens are modelled by a causal transformer with 3D rotary position embeddings, trained on synthetic indoor scenes (3D-FRONT, Aria Synthetic Environments).
works.method_zh: 带向量量化的稀疏三维卷积自编码器把高斯基元压缩成离散潜网格；序列化后的 token 由带三维旋转位置编码的因果 Transformer 建模，训练数据为合成室内场景（3D-FRONT、Aria Synthetic Environments）。

paper.title: GaussianGPT: Towards Autoregressive 3D Gaussian Scene Generation

works.title: Gen3R
works.description: Gen3R generates a scene from one or a few images as an RGB video together with its 3D geometry (camera poses, depth maps and a global point cloud), by letting a video diffusion model and the VGGT reconstruction model share aligned latents; code and checkpoints are open.
works.description_zh: Gen3R 由一张或几张图像生成场景：输出 RGB 视频及其三维几何（相机位姿、深度图和全局点云），做法是让视频扩散模型与 VGGT 重建模型共享对齐的潜变量；代码与检查点已开源。
works.idea_en: Coupling a generator with a reconstruction model means every generated view arrives with geometry that can be checked, a step from plausible footage toward measurable space.
works.idea_zh: 把生成器与重建模型耦合，每个生成视角都带有可检验的几何，从“看起来合理的画面”向“可测量的空间”迈进一步。
works.method: An adapter on VGGT's tokens produces geometric latents regularised to align with a pre-trained video diffusion model's appearance latents; the two are generated jointly and decoded into frames, cameras, depth and point clouds.
works.method_zh: 在 VGGT 的 token 上训练适配器，得到与预训练视频扩散模型外观潜变量对齐的几何潜变量；两者联合生成，再解码为画面、相机、深度与点云。

paper.title: Gen3R: 3D Scene Generation Meets Feed-Forward Reconstruction

works.title: PixWorld
works.description: One open diffusion model that both reconstructs the views it is given and generates the ones it is not: posed input images go in, and a pixel-aligned 3D Gaussian scene comes out in a single forward pass, from NTU and AIsphere (PixVerse).
works.description_zh: 一个同时完成重建与生成的开源扩散模型：对给定的视角做重建，对缺失的视角做生成；输入带位姿的图像，单次前向即可输出像素对齐的三维高斯场景。由南洋理工大学与爱诗科技（PixVerse）合作完成。
works.idea_en: When reconstruction and generation are one model, how much of a scene is captured versus invented becomes a matter of how many views you supply.
works.idea_zh: 当重建与生成是同一个模型时，场景中有多少是拍到的、有多少是想象的，就取决于你提供了多少视角。
works.method: Posed multi-view inputs are split into a clean subset (reconstruction) and a noisy subset (generation), processed by a two-stream diffusion transformer and decoded into pixel-aligned 3D Gaussians, with a flow-matching loss defined on rendered images plus a geometry-perception loss.
works.method_zh: 把带位姿的多视角输入分成干净子集（重建）和加噪子集（生成），由双流扩散 Transformer 处理并解码为像素对齐的三维高斯；损失直接定义在渲染图像上的流匹配目标，并加入几何感知损失。

paper.title: PixWorld: Unifying 3D Scene Generation and Reconstruction in Pixel Space

works.title: SimFoundry
works.description: From a short video of a real tabletop or room, NVIDIA's SimFoundry builds a physics-ready simulation scene (a Gaussian-splat background plus textured object meshes, including articulated ones) in under an hour, then generates 'digital cousins' that vary objects, layout and task; the code was released under Apache 2.0 in August 2026.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 的 SimFoundry 由一段真实桌面或房间的短视频，在一小时内自动搭建可做物理仿真的场景（高斯泼溅背景加带纹理的物体网格，包括可活动的关节物体），再生成改变物体、布局与任务的“数字表亲”；代码于 2026 年 8 月以 Apache 2.0 许可开源。
works.idea_en: A real setting becomes a family of controlled variants with the same affordances, and the authors show that evaluation in those variants predicts real-world results, the property a study would want from a simulated room.
works.idea_zh: 一个真实场景变成一组功能可供性相同、受控变化的变体，作者还表明在这些变体中的评估能预测真实世界的结果：这正是研究希望模拟房间具备的性质。
works.method: A modular pipeline segments every object (SAM 3), estimates depth (Depth Anything 3) and pose (FoundationPose), generates textured meshes (Hunyuan3D-2) and compiles an OmniGibson scene with physical parameters, task proposals and affordance-preserving variations.
works.method_zh: 模块化流程：分割每个物体（SAM 3）、估计深度（Depth Anything 3）与位姿（FoundationPose）、生成带纹理网格（Hunyuan3D-2），再编译成带物理参数、任务建议和保持可供性的变体的 OmniGibson 场景。
works.specs: video → sim scene in < 1 h · sim-vs-real policy evaluation: mean Pearson r = 0.911 (7 tasks, 5 policy architectures)

paper.title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation

works.title: EmbodiedGen V2
works.description: Horizon Robotics' open toolkit turns text, images and natural-language dialogue into simulation-ready assets, task-driven rooms and large multi-room scenes that load in Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Genesis, SAPIEN and PyBullet; version 2 (July 2026) follows EmbodiedGen (June 2025).
works.description_zh: 地平线的开源工具包：把文字、图像和自然语言对话变成可直接仿真的资产、按任务生成的房间以及大型多房间场景，可在 Isaac Sim、MuJoCo、Genesis、SAPIEN 和 PyBullet 中加载；第二版（2026 年 7 月）接续 2025 年 6 月的 EmbodiedGen。
works.idea_en: Authoring a task environment by conversation ('vibe coding' the scene) lowers the cost of building many variants of the same situation.
works.idea_zh: 通过对话来搭建任务环境（用“氛围编程”写场景），降低了为同一情境制作大量变体的成本。
works.method: A unified sim-ready representation links generated assets (with collision and affordance data), task-driven layouts, multi-room scene generation and a stateful LLM coding loop; the authors report 96.5% human acceptance of assets and 83.3% of task worlds usable without manual fixes.
works.method_zh: 以统一的“可仿真”表示串起生成资产（含碰撞与可供性数据）、按任务布局、多房间场景生成和有状态的语言模型编程循环；作者报告资产的人工认可率为 96.5%，83.3% 的任务世界无需人工修改即可使用。
works.specs: 96.5% asset acceptance · 83.3% task worlds usable as generated · Isaac Sim / MuJoCo / Genesis / SAPIEN / PyBullet

paper.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI

works.title: WorldSculpt
works.description: WorldSculpt turns a video of a cluttered room, given instance masks and 3D boxes, into hundreds of separate, complete object meshes in one shared frame; the authors also run it on Marble-generated splat worlds to break them into editable objects. Code, model and a benchmark are open.
works.description_zh: WorldSculpt 把一段杂乱房间的视频（附实例掩码与三维包围盒）变成同一坐标系下数百个独立、完整的物体网格；作者还把它用于 Marble 生成的泼溅世界，将其拆成可编辑的物体。代码、模型与基准均已开源。
works.idea_en: Splitting a world into individual objects is what makes it editable item by item: move the chair, remove the bag, keep everything else identical across conditions.
works.idea_zh: 把世界拆成一个个物体，才能逐件编辑：挪动椅子、拿走包，其余一切在不同实验条件间保持不变。
works.method: Pixal3D, a single-object 3D generative prior, is extended with a multi-view conditioning pathway so that each object is completed from occluded views and placed by its 3D box in a shared world frame.
works.method_zh: 在单物体三维生成先验 Pixal3D 上加入多视角条件通路，使每个物体都能从被遮挡的多个视角补全，并按其三维包围盒放置到共享的世界坐标系中。
works.specs: hundreds of objects per scene · per-object meshes

paper.title: WorldSculpt: Generating Compositional Worlds from Grounded Videos

works.title: SpatialGen
works.description: Manycore's open model generates a 3D indoor scene from a semantic room layout plus a text prompt or reference image: it synthesises matching colour, geometry and semantic views from many viewpoints and fuses them into Gaussian splats (3DV 2026).
works.description_zh: 群核科技的开源模型：根据语义房间布局加一句文字或一张参考图生成三维室内场景，从多个视点合成彼此一致的颜色、几何与语义视图，再融合为高斯泼溅（3DV 2026）。
works.idea_en: Fixing the floor plan and furniture boxes while sampling appearance separates what an experimenter controls from what the model varies.
works.idea_zh: 固定平面布局和家具包围盒、只让外观随机变化，把实验者控制的部分和模型变化的部分分开了。
works.method: A multi-view, multi-modal diffusion model conditioned on a 3D layout and a reference image (generated from text if needed) predicts colour images, scene-coordinate maps and semantic maps per view, which are optimised into 3D Gaussians; it is trained on a synthetic dataset of 12,328 annotated scenes with 57,440 rooms and 4.7M renderings.
works.method_zh: 多视角、多模态扩散模型以三维布局和参考图（需要时由文字生成）为条件，逐视角预测颜色图、场景坐标图和语义图，再优化为三维高斯；训练数据为包含 12,328 个标注场景、57,440 个房间和 470 万张渲染图的合成数据集。

works.title: SceneScape
works.description: SceneScape turns a text prompt and a camera path into a long walk-through video of an imagined place (a cave, a haunted house, a medieval forge) by building one textured mesh as it goes, so surfaces seen earlier stay consistent; NeurIPS 2023, open code.
works.description_zh: SceneScape 由一句文字和一条镜头路径生成穿行于想象场所（洞穴、鬼屋、中世纪铁匠铺）的长视频，边走边构建同一个带纹理的网格，使先前看到的表面保持一致；NeurIPS 2023，代码开源。
works.idea_en: Keeping an explicit mesh while painting new views with an image model was one of the first ways to make an endless generated walk remember where it had been.
works.idea_zh: 一边用图像模型绘制新视角、一边维护显式网格，是让无限生成的漫游“记得走过哪里”的最早做法之一。
works.method: Each new frame is rendered from a unified mesh, its missing regions are filled by a pre-trained text-to-image inpainting model, a monocular depth model fine-tuned at test time for consistency lifts the new content, and it is fused back into the mesh.
works.method_zh: 每一帧先从统一网格渲染，缺失区域由预训练的文生图补全模型填充，再用测试时微调以保持一致的单目深度模型把新内容提升到三维，并融合回网格。
